summary: Built the %ProgramData% kept-folder Fact InProgramDataNoKeptFolderMovesItsParent in LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests, with a named refusal for a bad known folder (ChooseProgramDataTestsRoot) and for a tests root this user cannot create (CreateRoot, so both deliberate roots get it). The reflection guard now pins the new Fact and asserts the class's Fact/Theory set equals the pinned list. The ScanResult.LastAccessKept remark and the SL-096 limits state what was measured, and a new SL-097 doc holds the numbers per sample set, spike #3 as measured (no 'falsified'), the Q-208 evidence, and the Windows 10 hand-off. The full suite is 804/804 (789 before), Fitness has 0 violations, rules-parity AGREEs in both shells, the Fact was clean 3 runs in a row and under both TEMP values, and widening Scanner.cs:340 turns it red at 'kept 4 of 7'. Scanner.cs is untouched, and Windows 10 and elevated scans stay filed for a person.

files.why: Added the never-skipped Fact InProgramDataNoKeptFolderMovesItsParent (asked == 7, kept == 7, still-old == kept, each with its own message) and a class remark.

Added ChooseProgramDataTestsRoot (known folder, named refusal when blank, unqualified, under the Windows folder, or the Windows folder cannot be told). CreateRoot now wraps only Directory.CreateDirectory so a refused create is a named InvalidOperationException (Q-210, review m2); the compression refusal is unchanged.

Pinned the new Fact in TheWindowsFolderFactsRunInTheDefaultSuite and made that test assert the type's Fact/Theory methods equal the pinned list exactly (review M2). Added TheMeasuredLastAccessLimitIsWrittenWhereTheTreeSaidUnmeasured, which pins the C4 records.
Feeds ChooseProgramDataTestsRoot: good roots, blank, whitespace, relative, drive-relative, under-Windows, and an untellable Windows folder (C-009).
Added ATestsRootThatCannotBeCreatedIsRefusedByName, fed a tests root whose parent is a file (no ACL change needed).

Comment only. Replaced 'unmeasured and not corrected' with the measured statement, naming Windows 10 and elevated scans as unmeasured. The re-scan 'counted out even when nothing moved' gap is kept as it was.
Limits paragraph now says SL-097 measured %ProgramData% and %ProgramFiles% on Windows 11 26200, non-elevated, and points to the SL-097 doc. The :91-92 re-scan gap is untouched.

Measurement record: environment, method, per-set results with controls, spike #3 as measured, Q-208 evidence, not measured and why, the Windows 10 person-run command, what was built, and the route if the Fact goes red.

obligations.how: InProgramDataNoKeptFolderMovesItsParent builds the nested 7-folder tree under <CommonApplicationData>\fsa-tests\<guid>, back-dates 48 h and scans it. It passed: 'kept 7 of 7; 7 of 7 folders still at least 47 h old; moved: none'.

A green run of the whole LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests class (6/6) prints the Windows\Temp lines 'kept 4 of 7 ... moved: <root>, plain, links' for all 3 spellings. Those Facts assert kept == still-old, so they go red where nothing moves, which makes the same run's ProgramData 'moved: none' a measurement. The LOCALAPPDATA line prints 'kept 7 of 7 ... moved: none'.

Ran the class under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and under TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp: both exit 0 with the same lines and a C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests path. The Fact takes its root from the known folder. The -e TEMP/TMP form was checked to reach the test host (a tree appeared under the overridden TEMP).
Ran the single-Fact filter 3 times in a row: exit 0 each time, 'kept 7 of 7 ... moved: none' each time. The full suite also passed. No red, so no opt-in and no loosening.

InTree asserts the <guid> tree is gone after Dispose. C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests holds 0 entries after all runs, and names present after the runs minus names before was 0. The empty fsa-tests parent stays, as designed.

Reworded the ScanResult.cs remark and the SL-096 limits and added the SL-097 doc. TheMeasuredLastAccessLimitIsWrittenWhereTheTreeSaidUnmeasured checks the old phrases are gone, the SL-097 pointers and 'Windows 10' are present, the existing re-scan-gap sentences survive, and the doc has no 'falsified'.

Full suite 804/804. Fitness check run read-only with the engine's python over the working tree: 87 rules, 0 violations (only the import rule is unran, no code graph). rules-parity AGREE 18 facts in pwsh and powershell.exe.

TempTreeRootTests feeds ChooseProgramDataTestsRoot blank, whitespace, relative, drive-relative, three under-Windows spellings and an untellable Windows folder, all refused by name with the cause in the message. Good roots, including one that only shares the Windows folder's name, are accepted.

The SL-097 doc reports spike #3 as measured. Re-back-dated re-scans at +180 s and +20 min moved root, plain and links again with kept equal to the truth. The un-back-dated +30 s re-scan moved nothing yet counted 3 out, which is the existing gap. 'falsified' appears nowhere, and ScanResult.cs and the SL-096 :91-92 sentences are untouched. A test pins all of it.

mutation.find: It is not a new limit, and both of those places
mutation.replace: It is a falsified limit, and both of those places

obligations.how: nameof(InProgramDataNoKeptFolderMovesItsParent) is in the pinned array of TheWindowsFolderFactsRunInTheDefaultSuite, which now also asserts the type's methods carrying a Fact or Theory (inherit: true, so derived Fact attributes count) equal the pinned list exactly. LastAccessRuleCorpusTests.cs is in the files list.

Restated in the SL-097 doc ('If the %ProgramData% Fact goes red'). A red is first a finding to investigate, and nothing is made opt-in. Only a red shown to come from outside the scanner justifies the move to its own class, with a Trait, a FsaDefaultTestFilter clause, an OptInTraitTests pin, shared helpers and a wider Windows 10 filter, as a re-design. No Trait, filter clause, pin, separate class or doc-only fallback was added.
obligations.not_mutable: A recorded decision in a doc. No code path depends on the wording, and the test that pins the doc covers other phrases.

obligations.how: CreateRoot, which TempTree(string) and the default TempTree() both reach, now catches UnauthorizedAccessException and IOException from Directory.CreateDirectory and throws an InvalidOperationException naming the root, the cause and that the deliberate last-access tests need to create it and are never skipped. The message is true for every caller. The compression refusal passes through unwrapped.

mutation.find: catch (Exception e) when (e is UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException)

deviations: Review m2 and the design said 'TempTree(string) used unchanged'. The named create-refusal is built in TempTree.CreateRoot, around Directory.CreateDirectory only, not around the whole call from the constructor. TempTree(string) and the default TempTree() both reach it, so both deliberate roots get it. A failure of the compression branch's Directory.Delete is then not mislabelled as 'could not create'. The compression InvalidOperationException passes through unwrapped.

ChooseProgramDataTestsRoot also refuses when the Windows folder is blank or not fully qualified, not only when CommonApplicationData is bad. The design's refusal needs a Windows folder to compare against, and failing closed is red with a cause, never a vacuous pass.

Added TheMeasuredLastAccessLimitIsWrittenWhereTheTreeSaidUnmeasured, a small prose pin, because O-006/C-006 needs a test the engine can run and the design's check was a Select-String command. It also holds review M1's requirement that the SL-097 doc says no 'falsified'.

Added tests in TempTreeRootTests and TempTreeTests so C-009 (a bad known folder) and review m2 (a refused create) are fed by real tests. Neither needs an ACL change: the create refusal uses a tests root whose parent is a file.

Resolved the design's taste disagreements as the design leaned: the Fact lives in LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests, the root is a fixed <CommonApplicationData>\fsa-tests parent left in place, the numbers are in a new SL-097 doc rather than folded into the SL-096 doc, and the C:\Windows-outside-Temp data (7 of 12 moved; Tasks and tracing did not) is recorded as evidence for Q-208 and not acted on.
No KnownWorkarounds entry or setting was added: this slice adds no step-around of an outside defect. It decides not to extend an internal counter correction (Q-159).
not_built: Windows 10 measurement (C3): no Windows 10 machine here, and the Sandbox is Windows 11 26100 with EnableLUA=0 where luafv refuses to load (error 1275). Filed for a person; the command is in the SL-097 doc.
Elevated scan with luafv loaded in %ProgramData% and %ProgramFiles%: needs an administrator. Filed for a person.

A %ProgramFiles% or %ProgramFiles(x86)% fixture or standing probe: a standard user cannot create a tree there, and probing existing folders would move real install folders' last access on every run. The verdict is recorded from the existing-folder measurements.
A re-scan test and a re-scan limit sentence in ScanResult.cs: the existing 'counted out even when nothing moved' gap already covers it, and LastAccessKept is internal (Q-159).

A fitness rule or plant row for the %ProgramData% root or for 'nothing corrects outside %SystemRoot%': the design declares none, and widening Scanner.cs:340 is caught behaviourally by the new Fact (mutation run: red at 'kept 4 of 7').
follow_ups: A person with a Windows 10 PC runs the command in docs/design/SL-097-last-access-outside-the-windows-folder.md (the LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests, LastAccessTests and HeldOpenTreeTests filter) and reports every 'moved:' line (Q-205).
A person with an administrator token measures an elevated scan with luafv loaded in %ProgramData% and %ProgramFiles%, only if LastAccessKept stops being internal (Q-159) or the app is run elevated.
Q-208: the SL-097 doc records the investigation's C:\Windows-outside-Temp data (7 of 12 parents moved; Tasks and tracing did not) for whichever slice takes it.
The CloudRig and SyncRootRig still root in the inherited temp folder and are exempt by name from the route rule (SL-096). That exemption is out of scope here.
C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests stays as an empty folder visible to every user. Remove it by hand if that is unwanted, or switch to a per-run parent as spike #2 measured.
